name: Mariana O.
fear_named: Fear of pain from a previous bad extraction
text: I hadn't been to the dentist in eight years. My fear was about pain — a bad extraction I had when I was younger. She walked me through everything before touching me, paused whenever I raised my hand, and finished in three short sessions instead of one long one. The cleaning didn't hurt. I almost cried in the chair from relief.
relief_named: Three short sessions, zero pain, full cleaning

name: James W.
fear_named: Couldn't find an English-speaking dentist after two years
text: I'd been putting off a root canal for a year because I couldn't explain my symptoms in Spanish without panic. She speaks fluent English, listened to the full history, and gave me a written treatment plan I could actually take home and read. The procedure was calmer than any treatment I've had in London.
relief_named: Fluent English + a plan I could take home

name: Verónica C.
fear_named: Embarrassment about years without going to the dentist
text: Sentí mucha vergüenza al llegar. No me hizo sentir mal en ningún momento. Antes de tocarme me preguntó tres veces si estaba lista. Cuando necesité parar, paramos. Salí con un plan escrito, sin sorpresas, y con la tranquilidad de saber qué necesitaba y cuánto costaba.
relief_named: Sin sermones · plan escrito · respeto total
